feeds.title: Canadian Fencing Federation
feeds.description: The CFF is a non-profit, amateur sports association and is the national governing body of fencing. It includes ten provincial fencing associations, which in turn represent eighty local clubs from coast to coast. Its mandate is to establish, develop and support fencing in Canada and to represent Canada on the international scene.

feeds.title: FencingClassics
feeds.description: J. Christoph Amberger is a native West Berliner. As a member of two German student Corps, he fought 7 sharp Mensuren. He has been fencing competitively since 1984 and today coaches youth teams and adult fencing classes at Baltimore Fencing Center in Timonium, Maryland. He posts blogs on fencing.

feeds.title: A Fencer's Ramblings
feeds.description: Hi I'm Henry Walker. I'm a Fencing and History Nut Extraordinaire. While I am tending toward 16th century at the moment, I am and have been interested in history for a long time. Hence the fencing focuses more on the Renaissance period than the modern.

feeds.title: Australian Fencing
feeds.description: The Australian Fencing Federation (AFF) is the National Governing Body of Fencing in Australia and has State and Territory members. As the NGB, AFF is responsible for furthering the interests of the sport of fencing, including fostering growth within the sport, Coaching and Officiating education, establishing domestic competition rules, athlete protection policies, and more.

feeds.title: Sydney Sabre Blog
feeds.description: Sydney Sabre was founded in December 2011 by a small group of nerds who were hooked on fencing. We wanted to create the first dedicated training centre for sabre in Australia, because we were sick of lugging our fencing bags around between various high school gyms. Check out the posts to get more info and inspiration.

feeds.title: The Fencing Coach
feeds.description: The Fencing Coach is a great resource for fencing training, philosophies, and leadership ideas.

feeds.title: Thame Duellists Fencing Club
feeds.description: Thame Duellists Fencing Club is a club in Oxfordshire, UK. Find posts and updates on fencing.

feeds.title: Fencing.Net
feeds.description: Fencing.Net is the leading online news source, guide and community to the world of Olympic/Sport Fencing. Fencing.net is the best and oldest resource for beginners learning the sport of fencing. Find Fencing news, online community, guides, and equipment reviews.

feeds.title: Academy of Fencing Masters Blog
feeds.description: Academy of Fencing Masters is a new concept fencing club and academy. An academy is where learning takes place; here fencers will learn about fencing and how to apply those skills to life. This academy takes the training experience beyond that of a student learning about fencing to an individual learning about life. Find Posts and updates on fencing.

feeds.title: Fencing Bear at Prayer
feeds.description: Hi I'm Rachel Brown. I am a not-so-mild mannered associate professor of medieval European history specializing in the study of devotion and prayer. I am convinced that there is a profound link between fencing and prayer, our souls like swords to be wielded by God.

feeds.title: The Fencing Hindquarters
feeds.description: Find posts and updates on Historical fencing in the Netherlands and other bits and pieces.

feeds.title: Knights bridge Fencing Blog
feeds.description: We run epee club for Adults and Children's on any age. Fencing is not only a great exercise is is also great fun. We are a friendly, happy and inclusive fencing club based in central London close to Earls Court station. Find posts and updates on fencing.

feeds.title: Charles Ellis Fencing
feeds.description: My name is Robert Anderson and I am a K-3 teacher at Charles Ellis Montessori Academy. I have been fencing for about 6 years and thought it would be great to share my knowledge and experience with students. I also update posts on fencing.

feeds.title: The Swordmaster's Grimoire
feeds.description: Hi I'm Adam Crown. I have black Belt (karate) and also studied aikido, Shorinji Kenpo, iaido, kendo, and boxing. I post and update on fencing.

feeds.title: Climbing the Fence
feeds.description: Find posts and updates on fencing.

feeds.title: Scottish Fencing
feeds.description: Scottish Fencing is the governing body for the sport of fencing in Scotland. It has responsibility for domestic fencing in Scotland and for international fencing where Scotland competes as a separate nation. Responsibility for international fencing where Britain competes as a nation rests with British Fencing.

feeds.title: LeonPaul.com Blog
feeds.description: Leon Paul we manufacture high-quality fencing equipment in our own factory in London. Run by Olympic fencers we specialize in design cutting edge fencing equipment. Find posts and updates on fencing.

feeds.title: Lilov Fencing Academy Blog
feeds.description: Lilov Fencing Academy ('LFA') is one of top private fencing programs in the United States established in 1992 by a father and son team with over 60 years of combined coaching experience. Learn from professional fencers and fencing teachers and find posts and updates on fencing.

feeds.title: Front Range Fencing Club
feeds.description: Front Range Fencing Club provides Fencing Classes For Children, Teens And Adults. Recreational Fencing Practice And Competitive Fencing Training. Find posts and updates on fencing.

feeds.title: Mary Griffith
feeds.description: Mary Griffith is a longtime nonfiction writer who is stepping less and less gingerly into fiction. Find posts and updates on fencing, writing mysteries about fencing, and occasional rants for all occasions.

feeds.title: I am a fencer
feeds.description: Axel is one of the leading instructors in Historical European Martial Arts, having taught in over 20 countries. He is also the most successful tournament fencer in the world, having won several international titles in several weapon categories in full contact steel weapon fights. He posts videos on workshops, lectures, individual coaching for technique and skill development.

feeds.title: Fencing Feels
feeds.description: For the feels that affect only fencers, let us know if you guys have anything to say. We posts and update on fencing.
